BreakGlassLedger's storage was upgraded from a single mutable object (invoke() then recordReview() overwrote the same file in place, silently destroying the original unreviewed state) to two proper chained records (INVOKED, REVIEWED) -- a real soundness fix, not just an evidence-hardening retrofit, since the prior design could lose the original emergency-access moment it was supposed to be auditing.
ledger_tamper_evidence_hardening.excluded_by_design: ModelInvocationLedger deliberately has neither hash-chain nor signature (documented in its own class javadoc): plain usage telemetry, no promotion gate, low stakes. ContractSelectorLedger already uses real Ed25519 signatures (a stronger mechanism) rather than hash-chaining. DurableStateLedger and OfficialLearningLedger already had hash-chaining before this session.
